## Added

- New `--extract-structured` mode that emits JSON containing per-page text spans (with font size, position, bold/italic flags) alongside a markdown reconstruction of the page.
- `--structured-format` option (`full` or `markdown`) to control whether spans are included in the output.
- Block-based markdown rendering: multi-line headings are merged, body lines collapse into paragraphs, bullet lists join with continuation lines, and table regions are detected via column-anchor alignment with tolerance for left/right-aligned cells.
- Inline emphasis collapsing: adjacent spans sharing the same bold/italic state share opening and closing markers instead of emitting them per span.

## Changed

- Added `serde` (with `derive`) as a direct dependency for structured-output serialization.
